if Shop1Manager == nil then
    Shop1Manager = class({})
end

Shop1Managers = {}

Shop1Manager._event_registered = Shop1Manager._event_registered or false

Shop1Managers.debug = Shop1Managers.debug or false
Shop1Managers.motion_debug = Shop1Managers.motion_debug or false

Shop1Managers.level_map = { [1] = 1, [2] = 10, [3] = 20, [4] = 30 }
require("spawn_wall_manager")

local function GetShop1ItemKV(name)
    if not name or not Shop1ItemsKV then
        return nil
    end
    local kv = Shop1ItemsKV[name]
    if not kv and Shop1ItemsKV["Shop1 Items"] then
        kv = Shop1ItemsKV["Shop1 Items"][name]
    end
    return kv
end

local function NormalizeCareer(raw)
    if raw == nil then
        return nil
    end
    local s = tostring(raw)
    if s == "" or s == "none" then
        return nil
    end
    return s
end

local function IsSupportCareer(career)
    return career and string.lower(career) == "support"
end

function Shop1Managers:InitPlayer(pid)
    local mgr
    if not Shop1Managers[pid] then
        mgr = Shop1Manager()
        mgr.pid = pid
        Shop1Managers[pid] = mgr
    end

    mgr = Shop1Managers[pid]


    if not mgr.Slots then
        mgr.Slots = {}
    end

    for key, entindex in pairs(GameState.spawn_points[pid].good) do
        mgr.Slots[key] = -1
    end


    mgr:Start()
end

function Shop1Manager:Start()
    local raw = LoadKeyValues("scripts/npc/shop config/shop1.txt")

    if not raw then
        return
    end

    -- 兼容两种写法："ShopItems" 根 或者直接是条目
    local kv = raw.ShopItems or raw

    self:LoadShopItems(kv)
    self:BuildEquipPool()
    self:RegisterShopEvents()
    self:SyncToClient()
end

function Shop1Manager:LoadShopItems(kv)
    self.items = {}

    local now = GameRules:GetGameTime()

    for idStr, data in pairs(kv) do
        local id = tonumber(idStr)
        if id then
            local base_price   = tonumber(data.price) or 0
            local price_factor = tonumber(data.price_factor) or 1.0
            local unlock_delay = tonumber(data.unlock_time) or 0
            local grade        = tonumber(data.grade) or 1
            local name         = data.name or ""

            local price_table  = {}
            if data.price_table then
                for key, value in pairs(data.price_table) do
                    price_table[tonumber(key)] = tonumber(value)
                end
            end

            self.items[id] = {
                base_price   = base_price,         -- 初始价格
                price_factor = price_factor,       -- 价格倍率
                unlock_time  = now + unlock_delay, -- 解锁时间
                unlock_delay = unlock_delay,
                grade        = grade,              -- 商品等级（装备等级）
                buy_count    = 0,                  -- 已购买次数
                name         = name,
                price_table  = price_table
            }
        end
    end
end

function Shop1Manager:BuildEquipPool()
    self.equip_pool = {}

    local added = {}

    if AbilityKV then
        for name, data in pairs(AbilityKV) do
            if type(data) == "table"
                and data.Shop == 1
                and data.Open == 1 then
                if not added[name] then
                    table.insert(self.equip_pool, name)
                    added[name] = true
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

function Shop1Manager:RegisterShopEvents()
    if self._event_registered then
        return
    end
    self._event_registered = true
    CustomGameEventManager:RegisterListener(
        "shop_buy_request",
        function(_, keys) self:OnBuyRequest(keys) end
    )
    CustomGameEventManager:RegisterListener(
        "shop1_click_select",
        function(_, keys) self:OnClickSelect(keys) end
    )
end

function Shop1Managers:DebugLog(...)
    if self.debug then
        print("[Shop1Manager]", ...)
    end
end

function Shop1Managers:MotionLog(...)
    if self.motion_debug then
        print("[Shop1Motion]", ...)
    end
end

function Shop1Managers:GetDummyLevel(lvl)
    return self.level_map[lvl] or 1
end

---------------------------------------------------------
-- 当前价格（带购买次数和倍率）
---------------------------------------------------------
function Shop1Manager:GetCurrentPrice(id)
    id = tonumber(id)
    local cfg = self.items[id]
    if not cfg or not cfg.price_table then return 0 end

    local count = (cfg.buy_count or 0) + 1
    if count < 1 then count = 1 end

    local price = cfg.price_table[count]
    if price == nil then
        local max_count = 0
        for key, _ in pairs(cfg.price_table) do
            if key > max_count then
                max_count = key
            end
        end
        price = cfg.price_table[max_count] or cfg.base_price or 0
    end

    return math.floor(price)
end

---------------------------------------------------------
-- 同步数据到客户端 UI
---------------------------------------------------------
function Shop1Manager:SyncToClient()
    local data_items = {}

    for id, cfg in pairs(self.items) do
        data_items[id] = {
            price        = self:GetCurrentPrice(id),
            unlock_time  = cfg.unlock_time,
            unlock_delay = cfg.unlock_delay,
            grade        = cfg.grade,     -- 商品等级（装备等级）
            level        = cfg.buy_count, -- 用作 UI 显示“购买次数”的话
            name         = cfg.name,
        }
    end

    local data = { items = data_items }
    if Shop1EnhanceManager and Shop1EnhanceManager.GetClientState then
        data.enhance = Shop1EnhanceManager:GetClientState(self.pid)
    end

    local pid = self.pid

    if pid then
        local p = PlayerResource:GetPlayer(pid)
        if p then
            CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToPlayer(p, "shop_data_update", data)
        end
        return
    end

    CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToAllClients("shop_data_update", data)
end

---------------------------------------------------------
-- 购买请求
---------------------------------------------------------
function Shop1Manager:OnBuyRequest(keys)
    local pid = keys.PlayerID
    if self.pid ~= pid then
        return
    end

    local id = tonumber(keys.id)

    if not id then
        print("[Shop] ERROR: invalid id", keys.id)
        return
    end

    local player = PlayerResource:GetPlayer(pid)
    if not player then return end

    local hero = player:GetAssignedHero()
    if not hero then return end

    local cfg = self.items[id]
    if not cfg then
        print("[Shop] ERROR: no config for id", id)
        return
    end

    -----------------------------------------------------
    -- 解锁时间检查
    -----------------------------------------------------
    local now = GameRules:GetGameTime()
    if now < cfg.unlock_time then
        print("[Shop] id", id, "not unlocked yet")
        return
    end

    -----------------------------------------------------
    -- 金币检查 & 扣费
    -----------------------------------------------------
    local price = self:GetCurrentPrice(id)
    local gold  = PlayerResourceExt:GetAmount(pid, "gold")

    if gold < price then
        print("[Shop] not enough gold, need", price, "have", gold)
        return
    end

    PlayerResourceExt:AddAmount(pid, "gold", -price)

    cfg.buy_count = (cfg.buy_count or 0) + 1

    -----------------------------------------------------
    -- 随机一件装备
    -----------------------------------------------------
    if #self.equip_pool == 0 then
        print("[Shop] WARNING: equip_pool is empty")
        return
    end

    local equip_name = self.equip_pool[RandomInt(1, #self.equip_pool)]

    -----------------------------------------------------
    -- 装备等级 = 商品等级（从配置拿，不再依赖 JS 传）
    -----------------------------------------------------
    local grade = cfg.grade or 1
    grade = math.max(1, math.min(4, grade))
    local lvl = tonumber(grade)

    self:AddItem(hero, equip_name, lvl, nil, true, nil, true)

    -----------------------------------------------------
    -- 同步 UI & 日志
    -----------------------------------------------------
    self:SyncToClient()

    CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToPlayer(player, "shop_buy_success", {
        id    = id,
        level = cfg.buy_count, -- UI 如果还在显示 level，就当作“购买次数”
    })

    -- print(string.format(
    --     "[Shop] Player %d bought slot %d -> %s (grade=%d, price=%d, next_price=%d)",
    --     pid, id, equip_name, grade, price, self:GetCurrentPrice(id)
    -- ))
end

function Shop1Manager:OnClickSelect(keys)
    local pid = keys.PlayerID
    if self.pid ~= pid then
        return
    end
    local x = tonumber(keys.x)
    local y = tonumber(keys.y)
    local z = tonumber(keys.z) or 0
    if not x or not y then
        return
    end
    local pos = Vector(x, y, z)
    self:SelectNearestDummyByPos(pos, 125)
end

function Shop1Manager:AddItemRandomly(hero, lvl)
    local equipName = self.equip_pool[RandomInt(1, #self.equip_pool)]

    self:AddItem(hero, equipName, lvl, nil, nil, nil, false)
end

function Shop1Manager:AddItem(hero, name, lvl, slot, count_recruit, grant_enhance, grant_career_reward)
    local empty_slots = {}

    if not slot then
        for key, entindex in pairs(self.Slots) do
            if entindex == -1 then
                table.insert(empty_slots, key)
            end
        end

        if #empty_slots < 1 then
            return
        end

        local random = RandomInt(1, #empty_slots)
        slot = empty_slots[random]
    end

    if not slot then
        Shop1Managers:DebugLog("AddItem skipped, no slot", name, lvl)
        return
    end

    if not name or name == "" then
        Shop1Managers:DebugLog("AddItem skipped, invalid name", name, "slot", slot)
        return
    end

    -- name = "item_invoker_chaos_meteor"
    -- name = "item_drow_ranger_ranged_attack"
    -- name = "item_tiny_toss_tree"
    -- name = "item_crystal_maiden_crystal_nova"

    if grant_enhance == nil then
        grant_enhance = true
    end
    if grant_career_reward == nil then
        grant_career_reward = false
    end

    local final_name = name .. "_" .. lvl
    local ab = hero:FindAbilityByName(final_name)
    if not ab then
        ab = hero:AddAbility(final_name)
    end

    local was_empty = self.Slots and self.Slots[slot] == -1
    if ab then
        ab.raw_name = name
        ab:AddInstance_Shop1({
            level = lvl,
            pid = self.pid,
            slot = slot,
        })
        if count_recruit and was_empty then
            SpawnWallManager:OnShop1DummyRecruited(self.pid, hero)
        end
        if grant_career_reward then
            local item_kv = GetShop1ItemKV(name)
            local career = NormalizeCareer(item_kv and item_kv.Career)
            if IsSupportCareer(career) then
                local gold = CareerConfigKV[career].bonus_gold or 0
                PlayerResourceExt:AddAmount(self.pid, "gold", gold)
            end
        end
        if Shop1EnhanceManager and Shop1EnhanceManager.OnItemAcquired then
            local changed = Shop1EnhanceManager:OnItemAcquired(self.pid, name, lvl)
            if changed and self.SyncToClient then
                self:SyncToClient()
            end
        end
        if grant_enhance and tonumber(lvl) == 4 and Shop1EnhanceManager and Shop1EnhanceManager.StartSelection then
            local item_source = StripTrailingIndex(name)
            Timers:CreateTimer(0, function()
                Shop1EnhanceManager:StartSelection(self.pid, {
                    item_source = item_source,
                    force_unlocked = true,
                })
            end)
        end
    end
end

function Shop1Manager:RefreshItemsForEnhance()
    local pid = self.pid
    if not pid then
        return
    end

    local player = PlayerResource:GetPlayer(pid)
    if not player then
        return
    end

    local hero = player:GetAssignedHero()
    if not hero then
        return
    end

    local items = {}
    for slot, data in pairs(self.Slots or {}) do
        if data and data ~= -1 then
            local raw_name = self:GetRawNameFromData(data)
            local level = self:GetDataLevel(data)
            if raw_name and level then
                table.insert(items, {
                    slot = slot,
                    raw_name = raw_name,
                    level = level,
                })
            end
        end
    end

    for _, item in ipairs(items) do
        self:RemoveItem(item.slot)
    end

    for _, item in ipairs(items) do
        self:AddItem(hero, item.raw_name, item.level, item.slot, false, false, false)
    end
end

function Shop1Manager:FindSlotByDummy(dummy)
    if not dummy or dummy:IsNull() then return nil end
    dummy = self:ResolveShop1Dummy(dummy)
    if not dummy or dummy:IsNull() then return nil end

    local dummyIndex = dummy:GetEntityIndex()
    for slot, data in pairs(self.Slots) do
        if data and data ~= -1 and data.Dummy == dummyIndex then
            return slot, data
        end
    end

    return nil
end

function Shop1Manager:SelectNearestDummyByPos(pos, radius)
    if not pos then return end
    local bestEnt = nil
    local bestDist = nil
    for _, data in pairs(self.Slots or {}) do
        if data and data ~= -1 then
            local dummy = data.Dummy and EntIndexToHScript(data.Dummy)
            if dummy and not dummy:IsNull() then
                local selectEnt = dummy
                local proxyIndex = dummy.__shop1_selection_proxy
                if proxyIndex then
                    local proxy = EntIndexToHScript(proxyIndex)
                    if proxy and not proxy:IsNull() then
                        selectEnt = proxy
                    end
                end
                local dpos = selectEnt:GetAbsOrigin()
                local dist = (dpos - pos):Length2D()
                if dist <= radius and (not bestDist or dist < bestDist) then
                    bestDist = dist
                    bestEnt = selectEnt
                end
            end
        end
    end

    if bestEnt and PlayerResource and PlayerResource.NewSelection then
        PlayerResource:NewSelection(self.pid, { bestEnt:GetEntityIndex() })
    end
end

function Shop1Manager:ResolveShop1Dummy(unit)
    if not unit or unit:IsNull() then
        return unit
    end
    if unit.__shop1_proxy_dummy then
        local dummy = EntIndexToHScript(unit.__shop1_proxy_dummy)
        if dummy and not dummy:IsNull() then
            return dummy
        end
    end
    return unit
end

function Shop1Manager:GetGoodPointPos(slot)
    local points = GameState.spawn_points[self.pid] and GameState.spawn_points[self.pid].good
    if not points then return nil end
    return points[slot]
end

function Shop1Manager:GetMaxDragDistance()
    local points = GameState.spawn_points[self.pid] and GameState.spawn_points[self.pid].good
    if not points then return nil end

    local positions = {}
    for _, pos in pairs(points) do
        table.insert(positions, pos)
    end

    local maxDist = 0
    for i = 1, #positions do
        for j = i + 1, #positions do
            local dist = (positions[i] - positions[j]):Length2D()
            if dist > maxDist then
                maxDist = dist
            end
        end
    end

    return maxDist
end

function Shop1Manager:GetDummyUnitName(data)
    if not data then return nil end
    local dummy = data.Dummy and EntIndexToHScript(data.Dummy)
    if not dummy or dummy:IsNull() then return nil end
    return dummy:GetUnitName()
end

function Shop1Manager:GetRawNameFromData(data)
    if not data then return nil end
    local stats = data.Stats
    if stats and not stats:IsNull() then
        local ab = stats:GetAbility()
        if ab then
            local name = ab:GetAbilityName()
            return StripTrailingIndex(name)
        end
    end
    local autocast = data.Autocast
    if autocast and not autocast:IsNull() then
        local ab = autocast:GetAbility()
        if ab then
            local name = ab:GetAbilityName()
            return StripTrailingIndex(name)
        end
    end
    return nil
end

function Shop1Manager:GetHeroFromData(data)
    if not data then return nil end
    if data.Autocast and not data.Autocast:IsNull() then
        local parent = data.Autocast:GetParent()
        if parent and not parent:IsNull() then
            return parent
        end
    end
    if data.Stats and not data.Stats:IsNull() then
        local parent = data.Stats:GetParent()
        if parent and not parent:IsNull() then
            return parent
        end
    end
    return nil
end

function Shop1Manager:GetDataLevel(data)
    if not data then return nil end
    return (data.Autocast and data.Autocast.custom_level) or (data.Stats and data.Stats.custom_level)
end

function Shop1Manager:PrepareDummyForSynthesize(data)
    if not data then
        return
    end
    local dummy = data.Dummy and EntIndexToHScript(data.Dummy) or nil
    if dummy and not dummy:IsNull() then
        dummy.__autocast_destroying = true
        if WorldPanels and WorldPanels.DeletePanelsForEntity then
            WorldPanels:DeletePanelsForEntity(dummy)
        end
        if dummy.Stop then
            dummy:Stop()
        end
        if dummy.SetForceAttackTarget then
            dummy:SetForceAttackTarget(nil)
        end
        dummy:RemoveModifierByName("modifier_dummy_autocast")
    end
    local autocast = data.Autocast
    if autocast and not autocast:IsNull() then
        autocast.is_paused = true
    end
end

function Shop1Manager:CanSynthesizePair(dataA, dataB)
    if not dataA or not dataB then return false end
    if dataA.Moving or dataB.Moving then return false end

    local levelA = self:GetDataLevel(dataA)
    local levelB = self:GetDataLevel(dataB)
    if not levelA or not levelB or levelA ~= levelB then return false end
    if levelA >= 4 then return false end

    local nameA = self:GetDummyUnitName(dataA)
    local nameB = self:GetDummyUnitName(dataB)
    if not nameA or not nameB or nameA ~= nameB then return false end

    return true, levelA
end

function Shop1Manager:SynthesizePairSlotsImmediate(slotA, slotB, targetSlot)
    if not slotA or not slotB then return false end

    local dataA = self.Slots[slotA]
    local dataB = self.Slots[slotB]
    if not dataA or dataA == -1 or not dataB or dataB == -1 then return false end

    local ok, level = self:CanSynthesizePair(dataA, dataB)
    if not ok then return false end

    if not targetSlot then
        local slotsRemoved = { slotA, slotB }
        targetSlot = slotsRemoved[RandomInt(1, #slotsRemoved)]
    end

    local equipName = (#self.equip_pool > 0) and self.equip_pool[RandomInt(1, #self.equip_pool)] or nil

    self:PrepareDummyForSynthesize(dataA)
    self:PrepareDummyForSynthesize(dataB)

    local entA = dataA and dataA.Dummy or nil
    local entB = dataB and dataB.Dummy or nil

    self:RemoveItem(slotA)
    self.Slots[slotA] = -1

    Timers:CreateTimer(0.03, function()
        self:RemoveItem(slotB)
        self.Slots[slotB] = -1

        local player = PlayerResource:GetPlayer(self.pid)
        local hero = (player and player:GetAssignedHero()) or self:GetHeroFromData(dataA)
        if hero then
            if equipName then
                Shop1Managers:DebugLog("Synthesize immediate add", equipName, "lvl", level + 1, "slot", targetSlot)
                self:AddItem(hero, equipName, level + 1, targetSlot, false, nil, true)
            else
                Shop1Managers:DebugLog("Synthesize immediate failed, no equipName", slotA, slotB)
            end
        else
            Shop1Managers:DebugLog("Synthesize immediate failed, no hero", slotA, slotB)
        end
    end)

    return true
end

function Shop1Manager:SynthesizePairSlotsAnimated(slotMover, slotTarget, targetSlot, moveBoth)
    if not slotMover or not slotTarget then return false end

    local dataA = self.Slots[slotMover]
    local dataB = self.Slots[slotTarget]
    if not dataA or dataA == -1 or not dataB or dataB == -1 then return false end

    local ok, level = self:CanSynthesizePair(dataA, dataB)
    if not ok then return false end

    if not targetSlot then
        local slotsRemoved = { slotMover, slotTarget }
        targetSlot = slotsRemoved[RandomInt(1, #slotsRemoved)]
    end

    local equipName = (#self.equip_pool > 0) and self.equip_pool[RandomInt(1, #self.equip_pool)] or nil

    self:PrepareDummyForSynthesize(dataA)
    self:PrepareDummyForSynthesize(dataB)

    local motion = self:GetDragMotionParams()
    local function ResolveSlotByData(findData)
        for slot, v in pairs(self.Slots) do
            if v == findData then
                return slot
            end
        end
        return nil
    end

    local done = 0
    local expected = moveBoth and 2 or 1
    local function finishOne()
        done = done + 1
        if done < expected then return end

        local slotA = ResolveSlotByData(dataA) or slotMover
        local slotB = ResolveSlotByData(dataB) or slotTarget

        local entA = dataA and dataA.Dummy or nil
        local entB = dataB and dataB.Dummy or nil
        -- print(string.format("[SYN][Animated] source=Animated pid=%s slotA=%s slotB=%s target=%s lvl=%s entA=%s entB=%s time=%.3f",
        --     tostring(self.pid), tostring(slotA), tostring(slotB), tostring(targetSlot), tostring(level),
        --     tostring(entA), tostring(entB), GameRules:GetGameTime()))
        self:RemoveItem(slotA)
        self.Slots[slotA] = -1

        Timers:CreateTimer(0.03, function()
            self:RemoveItem(slotB)
            self.Slots[slotB] = -1

            local player = PlayerResource:GetPlayer(self.pid)
            local hero = (player and player:GetAssignedHero()) or self:GetHeroFromData(dataA)
            if hero then
                if equipName then
                    Shop1Managers:DebugLog("Synthesize animated add", equipName, "lvl", level + 1, "slot", targetSlot)
                    self:AddItem(hero, equipName, level + 1, targetSlot, false, nil, true)
                else
                    Shop1Managers:DebugLog("Synthesize animated failed, no equipName", slotMover, slotTarget)
                end
            else
                Shop1Managers:DebugLog("Synthesize animated failed, no hero", slotMover, slotTarget)
            end
        end)
    end

    self:AnimateDataToSlot(dataA, targetSlot, motion, finishOne)
    if moveBoth then
        self:AnimateDataToSlot(dataB, targetSlot, motion, finishOne)
    end

    return true
end

function Shop1Manager:AnimateDataToPos(data, targetPos, params, onFinish)
    if not data or not targetPos then
        if onFinish then onFinish() end
        return
    end

    local dummy = data.Dummy and EntIndexToHScript(data.Dummy)
    if not dummy or dummy:IsNull() then
        if onFinish then onFinish() end
        return
    end

    local dummy_sp = data.Autocast and data.Autocast.dummy_sp or nil

    params = params or self:GetDragMotionParams()
    local maxDuration = tonumber(params.max_duration) or tonumber(params.duration) or 1.0
    local minDuration = tonumber(params.min_duration) or 0
    local maxHeight = tonumber(params.max_height) or tonumber(params.height) or 200
    local steps = tonumber(params.steps) or 30
    local snapDistance = tonumber(params.snap_distance) or 0
    local maxDistance = tonumber(params.max_distance)
    if not maxDistance or maxDistance <= 0 then
        maxDistance = self:GetMaxDragDistance() or 0
    end
    if steps < 1 then steps = 1 end

    local startPos = dummy:GetAbsOrigin()
    local dist = (targetPos - startPos):Length2D()
    if dist <= snapDistance then
        local main_pos = nil
        if data.Autocast and data.Autocast.UpdateFormationAtPos then
            main_pos = data.Autocast:UpdateFormationAtPos(targetPos)
        else
            dummy:SetAbsOrigin(targetPos)
            main_pos = targetPos
        end
        if dummy_sp and not dummy_sp:IsNull() then
            dummy_sp:SetAbsOrigin(main_pos or targetPos)
        end
        if onFinish then onFinish() end
        return
    end

    if maxDistance <= 0 then
        maxDistance = dist
    end

    local distanceScale = math.min(dist / maxDistance, 1)
    local duration = maxDuration * distanceScale
    if duration < minDuration then
        duration = minDuration
    end
    if duration <= 0.03 then
        local main_pos = nil
        if data.Autocast and data.Autocast.UpdateFormationAtPos then
            main_pos = data.Autocast:UpdateFormationAtPos(targetPos)
        else
            dummy:SetAbsOrigin(targetPos)
            main_pos = targetPos
        end
        if dummy_sp and not dummy_sp:IsNull() then
            dummy_sp:SetAbsOrigin(main_pos or targetPos)
        end
        if onFinish then onFinish() end
        return
    end

    local stepCount = math.floor(steps * (duration / maxDuration))
    if stepCount < 1 then stepCount = 1 end
    local height = maxHeight * distanceScale

    Shop1Managers:MotionLog("Move", string.format("dist=%.1f", dist), string.format("scale=%.2f", distanceScale),
        string.format("dur=%.2f", duration), string.format("height=%.1f", height), "steps", stepCount)

    local step = 0
    local interval = duration / stepCount

    data.Moving = true

    Timers:CreateTimer(0, function()
        if not dummy or dummy:IsNull() then
            data.Moving = false
            if onFinish then onFinish() end
            return
        end

        local t = step / stepCount
        if t > 1 then t = 1 end

        local base = startPos + (targetPos - startPos) * t
        local z = startPos.z + (targetPos.z - startPos.z) * t + height * math.sin(math.pi * t)
        local pos = Vector(base.x, base.y, z)

        local main_pos = nil
        if data.Autocast and data.Autocast.UpdateFormationAtPos then
            main_pos = data.Autocast:UpdateFormationAtPos(pos)
        else
            dummy:SetAbsOrigin(pos)
            main_pos = pos
        end
        if GoodForward then
            dummy:SetForwardVector(GoodForward)
        end

        if dummy_sp and not dummy_sp:IsNull() then
            dummy_sp:SetAbsOrigin(main_pos or pos)
        end

        if t >= 1 then
            data.Moving = false
            if onFinish then onFinish() end
            return
        end

        step = step + 1
        return interval
    end)
end

function Shop1Manager:FindNearestGoodSlot(pos, radius)
    local points = GameState.spawn_points[self.pid] and GameState.spawn_points[self.pid].good
    if not points then return nil end

    local nearestSlot = nil
    local nearestDist = radius or 0

    for slot, pointPos in pairs(points) do
        local dist = (pointPos - pos):Length2D()
        if dist <= nearestDist then
            nearestDist = dist
            nearestSlot = slot
        end
    end

    return nearestSlot
end

function Shop1Manager:FindSynthesizeTargetSlotByPos(currentSlot, targetPos, radius)
    if not currentSlot or not targetPos then return nil end

    local dataA = self.Slots[currentSlot]
    if not dataA or dataA == -1 then return nil end

    local maxDist = radius or 200
    local bestSlot = nil
    local bestDist = nil

    for slot, dataB in pairs(self.Slots) do
        if slot ~= currentSlot and dataB and dataB ~= -1 then
            local dummy = dataB.Dummy and EntIndexToHScript(dataB.Dummy)
            local pos = (dummy and not dummy:IsNull()) and dummy:GetAbsOrigin() or self:GetGoodPointPos(slot)
            if pos then
                local dist = (pos - targetPos):Length2D()
                if dist <= maxDist then
                    local ok = self:CanSynthesizePair(dataA, dataB)
                    if ok and (not bestDist or dist < bestDist) then
                        bestDist = dist
                        bestSlot = slot
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return bestSlot
end

        targetPos.y)

    local motion = self:GetDragMotionParams()

    local targetData = self.Slots[targetSlot]

function Shop1Manager:AddItemLevel(hero, lvl)
    if not self.Slots then
        return
    end

    if next(self.Slots) == nil then
        return
    end

    for slot, value in pairs(self.Slots) do
        if type(value) == "table" then
            local stats = value.Stats

            if not stats then
                goto continue
            end

            if stats:IsNull() then
                goto continue
            end

            local level = stats.custom_level + (lvl or 1)

            if level > 4 then
                return
            end

            local ability = stats:GetAbility()
            if not ability then
                goto continue
            end

            local name = ability:GetAbilityName()
            local raw_name = StripTrailingIndex(name)

            self:RemoveItem(slot)
            self:AddItem(hero, raw_name, level, slot)

            return
        end
        ::continue::
    end
end

function Shop1Manager:AddItemLevelAll(hero, lvl)

            end

            local ability = stats:GetAbility()

            end

            local name = ability:GetAbilityName()
            local raw_name = StripTrailingIndex(name)

            self:RemoveItem(slot)

        end
        ::continue::
    end
end

function Shop1Manager:Synthesize(hero)
    if not hero or hero:IsNull() then return end

    local slots = self.Slots
    local slotInfos = {}

    for slot, data in pairs(slots) do
        if data and data.Autocast ~= -1 then
            local autocast = data.Autocast
            if autocast and autocast.custom_level and autocast.custom_level < 4 then
                local lv = autocast.custom_level
                local unitName = self:GetDummyUnitName(data)
                if unitName then
                    slotInfos[lv] = slotInfos[lv] or {}
                    slotInfos[lv][unitName] = slotInfos[lv][unitName] or {}
                    table.insert(slotInfos[lv][unitName], slot)
                end
            end
        end
    end

    for _, nameMap in pairs(slotInfos) do
        for _, points in pairs(nameMap) do
            while #points >= 2 do
                local slotA = table.remove(points)
                local slotB = table.remove(points)
                self:SynthesizePairSlotsImmediate(slotA, slotB)
            end
        end
    end
end

function Shop1Manager:RemoveItem(slot)
    local data = self.Slots[slot]
    if not data or data == -1 then
        self.Slots[slot] = -1
        return
    end
    local dummy_name = self:GetDummyUnitName(data) or "nil"
    local dummy_ent = data and data.Dummy or nil

        end

                end
            end

        ExecuteOrderFromTable({

            OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_STOP,
            Queue = false,

        local mod = dummy:FindModifierByName("modifier_dummy_autocast")
        if mod then

        end
        if dummy.Stop then
            dummy:Stop()
        end

        end

--[[
    Lua-controlled Selection Library by Noya
    
    Installation:
    - "require" this file inside your code in order to add the new API functions to the PlayerResource global
    - Additionally, ensure your game scripts custom_net_tables.txt has a "selection" entry
    - Finally, ensure that you have the following files correctly added and included in your panorama content folder
        selection.xml, and include line on custom_ui_manifest.xml, on layout/custom_game/ folder
        selection folder containing selection.js and selection_filter.js, on /scripts/ folder

    Usage:
    - Functions with unit_args can recieve an Entity Index, a NPC Handle, or a table of each type.
    - Functions with unit can recieve an Entity Index or NPC Handle

    * Create a new selection for the player
        PlayerResource:NewSelection(playerID, unit_args)

    * Add units to the current selection of the player
        PlayerResource:AddToSelection(playerID, unit_args)
    
    * Remove units by index from the player selection group
        PlayerResource:RemoveFromSelection(playerID, unit_args)
    
    * Returns the list of units by entity index that are selected by the player
        PlayerResource:GetSelectedEntities(playerID)

    * Deselect everything, selecting the main hero (which can be redirected to another entity)
        PlayerResource:ResetSelection(playerID)

    * Get the index of the first selected unit of the player
        PlayerResource:GetMainSelectedEntity(playerID)
    
    * Check if a unit is selected or not by a player, returns bool
        PlayerResource:IsUnitSelected(playerID, unit_args)

    * Force a refresh of the current selection on all players, useful after abilities are removed
        PlayerResource:RefreshSelection()
    
    * Redirects the selection of the main hero to another entity of choice
        PlayerResource:SetDefaultSelectionEntity(playerID, unit)
    
    * Redirects the selection of any entity to another entity of choice
        hero:SetSelectionOverride(unit)

    * Use -1 to reset to default
        PlayerResource:SetDefaultSelectionEntity(playerID, -1)
        hero:SetSelectionOverride(-1)

    Notes:
    - Enemy units that you don't control can't be added to the selection group of a player
    - This library requires "libraries/timers.lua" to be present in your vscripts directory.

--]]

function CDOTA_PlayerResource:NewSelection(playerID, unit_args)
    local player = self:GetPlayer(playerID)
    if player then
        local entities = Selection:GetEntIndexListFromTable(unit_args)
        CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToPlayer(player, "selection_new", {entities = entities})
    end
end 

function CDOTA_PlayerResource:AddToSelection(playerID, unit_args)
    local player = self:GetPlayer(playerID)
    if player then
        local entities = Selection:GetEntIndexListFromTable(unit_args)
        CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToPlayer(player, "selection_add", {entities = entities})
    end
end

function CDOTA_PlayerResource:RemoveFromSelection(playerID, unit_args)
    local player = self:GetPlayer(playerID)
    if player then
        local entities = Selection:GetEntIndexListFromTable(unit_args)
        CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToPlayer(player, "selection_remove", {entities = entities})
    end
end

function CDOTA_PlayerResource:ResetSelection(playerID)
    local player = self:GetPlayer(playerID)
    if player then
        CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToPlayer(player, "selection_reset", {})
    end
end

function CDOTA_PlayerResource:GetSelectedEntities(playerID)
    return Selection.entities[playerID] or {}
end

function CDOTA_PlayerResource:GetMainSelectedEntity(playerID)
    local selectedEntities = self:GetSelectedEntities(playerID) 
    return selectedEntities and selectedEntities["0"]
end

function CDOTA_PlayerResource:IsUnitSelected(playerID, unit)
    if not unit then return false end
    local entIndex = type(unit)=="number" and unit or IsValidEntity(unit) and unit:GetEntityIndex()
    if not entIndex then return false end
    
    local selectedEntities = self:GetSelectedEntities(playerID)
    for _,v in pairs(selectedEntities) do
        if v==entIndex then
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

function CDOTA_PlayerResource:RefreshSelection()
    Timers:CreateTimer(0.03, function()
        FireGameEvent("dota_player_update_selected_unit", {})
    end)
end

function CDOTA_PlayerResource:SetDefaultSelectionEntity(playerID, unit)
    if not unit then unit = -1 end
    local entIndex = type(unit)=="number" and unit or unit:GetEntityIndex()
    local hero = self:GetSelectedHeroEntity(playerID)
    if hero then
        hero:SetSelectionOverride(unit)
    end
end

function CDOTA_BaseNPC:SetSelectionOverride(reselect_unit)
    local unit = self
    local reselectIndex = type(reselect_unit)=="number" and reselect_unit or reselect_unit:GetEntityIndex()

    CustomNetTables:SetTableValue("selection", tostring(unit:GetEntityIndex()), {entity = reselectIndex})
end

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Internal
------------------------------------------------------------------------

require('libraries/timers')

if not Selection then
    Selection = class({})
end

function Selection:Init()
    Selection.entities = {} --Stores the selected entities of each playerID
    CustomGameEventManager:RegisterListener("selection_update", Dynamic_Wrap(Selection, 'OnUpdate'))
end

function Selection:OnUpdate(event)
    local playerID = event.PlayerID
    Selection.entities[playerID] = event.entities

    if Selection.ignore_next and Selection.ignore_next[playerID] then
        Selection.ignore_next[playerID] = nil
        return
    end

    if not Shop1Managers or not Shop1Managers[playerID] then
        return
    end

    local mgr = Shop1Managers[playerID]
    local entities = event.entities or {}
    local proxy_ent = nil
    local entity_count = 0
    for _, entid in pairs(entities) do
        entity_count = entity_count + 1
        local unit_check = EntIndexToHScript(entid)
        if unit_check and not unit_check:IsNull() and unit_check.__shop1_proxy_dummy then
            proxy_ent = entid
        end
    end
    if proxy_ent and entity_count > 1 then
        Selection.ignore_next = Selection.ignore_next or {}
        Selection.ignore_next[playerID] = true
        PlayerResource:NewSelection(playerID, { proxy_ent })

        local unit_proxy = EntIndexToHScript(proxy_ent)
        if unit_proxy and not unit_proxy:IsNull() and mgr.ResolveShop1Dummy then
            unit_proxy = mgr:ResolveShop1Dummy(unit_proxy)
        end
        local slot, data = mgr:FindSlotByDummy(unit_proxy)
        if not slot or not data then
            local player = PlayerResource:GetPlayer(playerID)
            if player then
                CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToPlayer(player, "shop1_dummy_selection", { ability = "" })
            end
            return
        end

        local ability_name = ""
        if data.Stats and not data.Stats:IsNull() then
            local ability = data.Stats:GetAbility()
            if ability then
                ability_name = ability:GetAbilityName()
            end
        end
        local player = PlayerResource:GetPlayer(playerID)
        if player then
            CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToPlayer(player, "shop1_dummy_selection", {
                ability = ability_name
            })
        end
        return
    end
    local ent = entities[1] or entities["0"]
    if not ent then
        for _, v in pairs(entities) do
            ent = v
            break
        end
    end
    if not ent then return end

    local unit = EntIndexToHScript(ent)
    if not unit or unit:IsNull() then return end

    if mgr.debug then
        print("[Shop1Manager] Selection update", playerID, "ent", ent, unit:GetUnitName())
    end
    if mgr.ResolveShop1Dummy then
        unit = mgr:ResolveShop1Dummy(unit)
        if not unit or unit:IsNull() then
            return
        end
    end

    local slot, data = mgr:FindSlotByDummy(unit)
    if not slot or not data then
        if not Selection.last_dummy then Selection.last_dummy = {} end
        Selection.last_dummy[playerID] = nil
        local player = PlayerResource:GetPlayer(playerID)
        if player then
            CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToPlayer(player, "shop1_dummy_selection", { ability = "" })
        end
        return
    end

    Selection.last_dummy = Selection.last_dummy or {}
    local last = Selection.last_dummy[playerID]
    Selection.last_dummy[playerID] = { slot = slot, ent = ent }

    -- When selecting another dummy, keep default behavior (just select new unit).

    local ability_name = ""
    if data.Stats and not data.Stats:IsNull() then
        local ability = data.Stats:GetAbility()
        if ability then
            ability_name = ability:GetAbilityName()
        end
    end

    local player = PlayerResource:GetPlayer(playerID)
    if player then
        CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToPlayer(player, "shop1_dummy_selection", {
            ability = ability_name
        })
    end
end

-- Internal function to build an entity index list out of various inputs
function Selection:GetEntIndexListFromTable(unit_args)
    local entities = {}
    if type(unit_args)=="number" then
        table.insert(entities, unit_args) -- Entity Index
    -- Check contents of the table
    elseif type(unit_args)=="table" then
        if unit_args.IsCreature then
            table.insert(entities, unit_args:GetEntityIndex()) -- NPC Handle
        else
            for _,arg in pairs(unit_args) do
                -- Table of entity index values
                if type(arg)=="number" then
                    table.insert(entities, arg)
                -- Table of npc handles
                elseif type(arg)=="table" then
                    if arg.IsCreature then
                        table.insert(entities, arg:GetEntityIndex())
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return entities
end

if not Selection.entities then Selection:Init() end

        MODIFIER_PROPERTY_OVERRIDE_ABILITY_SPECIAL_VALUE,
    }

function modifier_item_stats:GetModifierOverrideAbilitySpecial(params)
    if not self.tooltips then return 0 end

    if params.ability == self:GetAbility()
        and self.tooltips[params.ability_special_value] then
        --print("[Item AbilitySpecial]", self, params.ability_special_value, self.tooltips[params.ability_special_value])
        return 1
    end

    return 0
end

function modifier_item_stats:GetModifierOverrideAbilitySpecialValue(params)
    if not self.tooltips then return 0 end

    if not IsServer() then
        --print("[modifier_item_stats] Client", params.ability_special_value)
    end

    if params.ability == self:GetAbility()
        and self.tooltips[params.ability_special_value] then
        -- print("[Item AbilitySpecialValue]", self, params.ability_special_value,
        --     self.tooltips[params.ability_special_value])
        return self.tooltips[params.ability_special_value]
    end

    return 0
end

function modifier_item_stats:OnCreated()
    if not IsServer() then return end

    Timers:CreateTimer(0, function()
        self:InitStat()
    end)
end

function modifier_item_stats:InitStat()
    --print("[modifier_item_stats] Server", self)
    local parent = self:GetParent()
    local ability = self:GetAbility()
    if not ability then return end

    local pid = parent:GetPlayerOwnerID()
    if pid < 0 then return end

    local lvl = ability.custom_level or self.custom_level or 1
    self.level = lvl
    local name = ability.raw_name
    local raw_kv = ItemKV[name] or AbilityKV[name]
    local type = 1
    if raw_kv and raw_kv.Shop then
        type = tonumber(raw_kv.Shop)
    end

    local kv = {}
    if type == 1 then
        kv = Shop1ItemsKV[name] or {}
    elseif type == 2 then
        kv = Shop2ItemsKV[name] or {}
    elseif type == 3 then
        kv = Shop3ItemsKV[name] or {}
    end

    self.kv = kv

    self:CollectValues()
    self:SetHasCustomTransmitterData(true)
    self:SendBuffRefreshToClients()

    ability:SetLevel(self.level)
    self:ForceRefresh()

    local attrs = {}

    if kv.BonusAttribute then
        for k, v in pairs(kv.BonusAttribute) do
            local value_array = ParseArray(v)
            local attr_value = value_array[lvl]
            if attr_value ~= nil then
                attrs[k] = attr_value
            end
        end
    end

    if next(attrs) ~= nil then
        StatsManager:AddSource(pid, self:GetSourceId(), attrs, {
            type = "equip",
            item = name,
            level = lvl,
        })
    end
end

function modifier_item_stats:CollectValues()
    if not IsServer() then return end
    local ab = self:GetAbility()

    local kv = ab:GetAbilityKeyValues()
    local sp = kv.AbilityValues

    if not sp then return end

    self.tooltips = {}
    self.tooltips.BonusAttributeKeys = {}
    for k, v in pairs(sp) do
        if k == "Level" then
            self.tooltips[k] = self.level
        else
            local kv_value = ab:GetSpecialValueFor(k)

            local array = self.kv[k] or self.kv.BonusAttribute[k]

            if self.kv.BonusAttribute[k] then
                table.insert(self.tooltips.BonusAttributeKeys, k)
            end

            local value = 0
            if array then
                value = ParseArray(array)[self.level] or 0
            end
            self.tooltips[k] = value

            --print("[modifier_item_stats] tooltip", k, value, self.level)
        end
    end
end

function modifier_item_stats:OnDestroy()
    if not IsServer() then return end

    local parent = self:GetParent()
    local pid = parent:GetPlayerOwnerID()

    if pid >= 0 then
        StatsManager:RemoveSource(pid, self:GetSourceId())
    end

function damage_system:ProcessDamage(attacker, victim, keys)
    local is_monster = attacker:GetTeamNumber() == DOTA_TEAM_NEUTRALS

    if is_monster then
        return Monster_ProcessDamage(attacker, victim, keys)
    end

    local pid = attacker.GetPlayerID and attacker:GetPlayerID() or -1
    local s = PlayerStats:GetDisplay(pid)

    if not s or not victim or victim:IsNull() then return keys.damage end

    ----------------------------------------------------------
    -- 获取标签（attack/skill/projectile）
    ----------------------------------------------------------
    local label                        = victim.hit_label or "attack"
    local pure_pct                     = victim.pure_percent or 0
    local additional_lifesteal         = victim.lifesteal

    victim.hit_label                   = nil

    local source_damage                = 0
    local atk                          = s.game_final.Attack
    local final_damage                 = s.game_final.FinalDamagePct
    local base                         = victim.base_damage or 0
    local career_damage_bonus_pct      = victim.career_damage_bonus_pct or 1
    local career_crit_chance_bonus_pct = victim.career_crit_chance_bonus_pct or 0

    if label == "attack" then
        -- 普攻：（攻击力 + 普攻增伤）* 普攻增幅 * 最终伤害
        local flat = s.game_final.AttackDamageFlat or 0
        local pct = s.game_final.AttackDamagePct or 0
        source_damage = (atk + flat) * pct * final_damage
    elseif label == "projectile" then
        -- 弹幕：（攻击力 + 弹幕增伤 + 弹幕固伤）* 全弹幕增幅 * 最终伤害
        local flat = s.game_final.ProjectileDamageFlat or 0
        local pct = s.game_final.ProjectileDamagePct or 0
        local scale = victim.damage_scale or 1
        source_damage = ((atk * scale) + flat + base) * pct * career_damage_bonus_pct * final_damage

        -- DebugPrint("Label  ", label, "  atk  ", atk, " scale ", scale, "  flat  ", flat, "  base  ", base, "  pct  ", pct,
        --     "career_damage_bonus_pct  ", career_damage_bonus_pct, " final_damage  ", final_damage,
        --     "  source  ", source_damage)
    elseif label == "skill" then
        -- 技能：（攻击力 + 技能固伤）* 技能增幅 * 最终伤害
        local flat = s.game_final.SkillDamageFlat or 0
        local pct = s.game_final.SkillDmagePct or 0
        source_damage = (atk + flat + base) * pct * final_damage
        print("[Skill Damage]", atk, flat, pct, source_damage)
    end

    if source_damage < 0 then
        source_damage = 0
    end

    local crit
    if label ~= "skill" then
        pct = math.floor(BpToFlat(s.game_final.CritChangePct))
        pct = pct + career_crit_chance_bonus_pct
        pct = math.max(0, math.min(pct, 100))

        crit = RollPseudoRandomPercentage(pct, DOTA_PSEUDO_RANDOM_CUSTOM_GENERIC, attacker)
        if crit then

            local mul = BpToRatio(s.game_final.CritMulPct or 0)
            source_damage = (source_damage + flat) * mul
        end
    end

    ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 纯粹攻击
    ----------------------------------------------------------------
    local pure_damage = source_damage * pure_pct
    local after       = source_damage - pure_damage
    -- print("[Damage Calc]", source_damage, pure_damage, after)

    local flat        = s.game_final.PureAttackFlat or 0
    local pct         = s.game_final.PureAttackPct or 0
    pure_damage       = (pure_damage + flat) * pct

    ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 护甲 / 魔抗计算
    ----------------------------------------------------------------
    if label == "skill" then
        after = damage_system:ComputeMagicalAfterResist(attacker, victim, after, s)
    else
        after = damage_system:ComputePhysicalAfterArmor(attacker, victim, after, s)
    end

    ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 吸血
    ----------------------------------------------------------------
    local lifesteal_pct = s.game_final.LifeSteal or 0
    if lifesteal_pct > 0 then
        attacker:Heal(lifesteal_pct, nil)
    end

    ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 伤害金币
    ----------------------------------------------------------------
    reward_system:OnDamage(attacker, victim)

    if pure_pct > 0 then
        -- print("[Damage]", after, pure_damage, pure_pct)
    end

    local final = after + pure_damage

    if additional_lifesteal and additional_lifesteal > 0 then
        local heal = final * additional_lifesteal
        if heal > 0 then
            -- print("[additional_lifesteal]", additional_lifesteal, heal)
            attacker:Heal(heal, nil)
        end
    end



    if final > 0 then
        if crit then
            SendOverheadEventMessage(nil, OVERHEAD_ALERT_CRITICAL, victim, final, nil)
        else
            SendOverheadEventMessage(nil, OVERHEAD_ALERT_DAMAGE, victim, final, nil)
        end
    end

    return final
end

----------------------------------------------------------------
-- 工具：物理减伤（自带护甲穿透）
----------------------------------------------------------------
function damage_system:ComputePhysicalAfterArmor(attacker, victim, base_phys_damage, atk_stats)
    --SafePrintEntity(victim)

    if base_phys_damage <= 0 then return 0 end

    local armor = victim:GetPhysicalArmorValue(false) or 0

    -- 护甲穿透（攻击方）
    local pierce = 0
    if atk_stats then
        pierce = atk_stats.game_final.ArmorPierce or 0
    end

    local armor_eff = armor - pierce

    -- Dota 物理减伤公式：0.06 * armor / (1 + 0.06 * armor)
    local reduction = 0
    if armor_eff >= 0 then
        reduction = 0.06 * armor_eff / (1 + 0.06 * armor_eff)
    else
        reduction = 0.06 * armor_eff / (1 - 0.06 * armor_eff) -- 负护甲增伤
    end

    local after = base_phys_damage * (1 - reduction)
    return after
end

----------------------------------------------------------------
-- 工具：魔法减伤（带自定义魔抗）
----------------------------------------------------------------
function damage_system:ComputeMagicalAfterResist(attacker, victim, base_mag_damage, atk_stats)
    if base_mag_damage <= 0 then return 0 end

    local resist = victim:Script_GetMagicalArmorValue(false, nil) or 0

    if resist > 0.95 then resist = 0.95 end
    if resist < -0.99 then resist = -0.99 end

    local after = base_mag_damage * (1 - resist)
    return after
end

            -- 缓存到 itemPool

            })
        end
    end

    self.playerShops[pid] = {
        next_auto_refresh = now + self:GetRefreshTime(),
        items = {},
    }

    self:RollShop(pid)
    self:SendInventory(pid)
end

-- 每秒检查自动刷新
function Shop2Manager:Think()
    local now = GameRules:GetGameTime()
    local refreshTime = self:GetRefreshTime()

    for pid = 0, DOTA_MAX_TEAM_PLAYERS - 1 do
        if PlayerResource:IsValidPlayerID(pid) then
            local state = self.playerShops[pid]
            if state and now >= (state.next_auto_refresh or now) then
                state.next_auto_refresh = now + refreshTime
                self:RollShop(pid)
            end
        end
    end
end

-- 当前玩家的手动刷新消耗
function Shop2Manager:GetRefreshCost(pid)
    local base = self:GetBaseRefreshCost()
    local factor = self:GetCostFactor()
    local count = PlayerResourceExt:GetAmount(pid, "paid_refresh_shop2")
    local cost = math.floor(base * (factor ^ count))
    if cost < 0 then cost = 0 end
    return cost
end

-- 为玩家重新 roll 一组商品
function Shop2Manager:RollShop(pid)
    if #self.itemPool == 0 then return end

    local state = self.playerShops[pid]
    if not state then return end

    local slotCount = self:GetSlotCount()
    state.items = {}

    for i = 1, slotCount do
        local entry = self.itemPool[RandomInt(1, #self.itemPool)]
        local abilityName = entry.name
        local stats_kv = entry.stats_kv

        local level = RollItemLevel(PlayerStats:GetFinal(pid).MF, GameState:GetGameTime())

        local killPrices = ParseArray(stats_kv["Price_Kill"])
        local goldPrices = ParseArray(stats_kv["Price_Gold"])
        local woodPrices = ParseArray(stats_kv["Price_Wood"])
        local image = stats_kv["Image"]

        local currency = nil
        local price = 0

        if killPrices and killPrices[level] and killPrices[level] > 0 then
            currency = "kill"
            price = killPrices[level]
        elseif goldPrices and goldPrices[level] and goldPrices[level] > 0 then
            currency = "gold"
            price = goldPrices[level]
        elseif woodPrices and woodPrices[level] and woodPrices[level] > 0 then
            currency = "wood"
            price = woodPrices[level]
        end

        state.items[i] = {
            ability = abilityName,
            level = level,
            price = price,
            currency = currency,
            image = image,
        }
    end

    self:SendUpdate(pid)
end

-- 把当前 shop2 状态发给客户端
function Shop2Manager:SendUpdate(pid)
    local state = self.playerShops[pid]
    if not state then return end

    local payload = {
        refresh_time = self:GetRefreshTime(),
        next_refresh_time = state.next_auto_refresh or GameRules:GetGameTime(),
        refresh_cost = self:GetRefreshCost(pid),
        slot = self:GetSlotCount(),
        items = {},
    }

    for idx, item in pairs(state.items) do
        payload.items[idx] = {
            ability  = item.ability,
            level    = item.level,
            price    = item.price,
            currency = item.currency,
            image    = item.image
        }
    end

    CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToPlayer(
        PlayerResource:GetPlayer(pid),
        "shop2_update",
        payload
    )
end

-- 手动刷新
function Shop2Manager:OnManualRefresh(event)
    local pid = event.PlayerID
    if not PlayerResource:IsValidPlayerID(pid) then return end

    -- 免费刷新？
    local free = PlayerResourceExt:GetAmount(pid, "free_refresh_shop2")
    if free > 0 then
        PlayerResourceExt:AddAmount(pid, "free_refresh_shop2", -1)

        local state = self.playerShops[pid]
        if state then
            state.next_auto_refresh = GameRules:GetGameTime() + self:GetRefreshTime()
        end

        self:RollShop(pid)
        return
    end

    -- 付费刷新逻辑
    local cost = self:GetRefreshCost(pid)
    local kill = PlayerResourceExt:GetAmount(pid, "kill")

    if kill < cost then
        CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToPlayer(
            PlayerResource:GetPlayer(pid),
            "shop2_refresh_failed",
            { reason = "not_enough_kill", need = cost, have = kill }
        )
        return
    end

    -- 扣 kill
    if cost > 0 then
        PlayerResourceExt:AddAmount(pid, "kill", -cost)
    end

    -- 付费刷新次数 +1（影响价格）
    PlayerResourceExt:AddAmount(pid, "paid_refresh_shop2", 1)

    -- 刷新
    local state = self.playerShops[pid]
    if state then
        state.next_auto_refresh = GameRules:GetGameTime() + self:GetRefreshTime()
    end

    self:RollShop(pid)
end

function Shop2Manager:AddAbilityRandomly(hero, lvl)
    local entry = self.itemPool[RandomInt(1, #self.itemPool)]
    local abilityName = entry.name
    local pid = hero:GetPlayerID()

    if abilityName and abilityName ~= "" and pid then
        -- print("[AddAbilityRandomly]", abilityName, entry.stats_kv.Image, lvl)
        self:AddAbility(hero, pid, abilityName, entry.stats_kv.Image, lvl)
    end
end

-- 购买
function Shop2Manager:OnBuyRequest(event)
    local pid  = event.PlayerID
    local slot = tonumber(event.slot or -1)

    --print("\n========== [Shop2] OnBuyRequest ==========")
    --print("[Shop2] PlayerID =", pid, "slot =", slot)

    -- 玩家检查
    if not PlayerResource:IsValidPlayerID(pid) then
        print("[Shop2][ERROR] invalid player id")
        return
    end
    if slot < 1 then
        print("[Shop2][ERROR] invalid slot index")
        return
    end

    -- 商店状态
    local state = self.playerShops[pid]
    if not state then
        print("[Shop2][ERROR] playerShops[" .. pid .. "] is nil")
        return
    end
    --print("[Shop2] Found player shop state")

    -- 取商品
    local offer = state.items[slot]
    if not offer then
        print("[Shop2][ERROR] No offer found in slot", slot)
        return
    end

    -- print("[Shop2] Offer found:",
    --     "ability =", offer.ability,
    --     "level =", offer.level,
    --     "price =", offer.price,
    --     "currency =", tostring(offer.currency)
    -- )

    -- 玩家实体
    local player = PlayerResource:GetPlayer(pid)
    if not player then
        print("[Shop2][ERROR] Player object not found (disconnected?)")
        return
    end

    local hero = player:GetAssignedHero()
    if not hero then
        print("[Shop2][ERROR] Assigned hero not found")
        return
    end

    -- print("[Shop2] Hero =", hero:GetUnitName())

    local price    = offer.price or 0
    local currency = offer.currency

    -- print("[Shop2] Currency =", currency, "price =", price)

    -------------------------------------
    -- 扣费
    -------------------------------------

    if currency == "kill" then
        local kill = PlayerResourceExt:GetAmount(pid, "kill")
        -- print("[Shop2] Currency = kill, current =", kill)
        if kill < price then
            -- print("[Shop2][ERROR] Not enough kill resource")
            return
        end
        PlayerResourceExt:AddAmount(pid, "kill", -price)
        -- print("[Shop2] Deducted kill:", price, "new =", PlayerResourceExt:GetAmount(pid, "kill"))
    elseif currency == "wood" then
        local wood = PlayerResourceExt:GetAmount(pid, "wood")
        -- print("[Shop2] Currency = wood, current =", wood)
        if wood < price then
            -- print("[Shop2][ERROR] Not enough wood")
            return
        end
        PlayerResourceExt:AddAmount(pid, "wood", -price)
        -- print("[Shop2] Deducted wood:", price)
    elseif currency == "gold" then
        local gold = PlayerResourceExt:GetAmount(pid, "gold")
        -- print("[Shop2] Currency = gold, current =", gold)
        if gold < price then
            -- print("[Shop2][ERROR] Not enough gold")
            return
        end
        PlayerResourceExt:AddAmount(pid, "gold", -price)
        -- print("[Shop2] Deducted gold:", price, "new =", PlayerResource:GetGold(pid))
    else
        print("[Shop2][ERROR] Unknown currency:", tostring(currency))
        return
    end

    -------------------------------------
    -- 添加 Ability
    -------------------------------------

    self:AddAbility(hero, pid, offer.ability, offer.image, offer.level)

    -------------------------------------
    -- 客户端事件
    -------------------------------------

    -- print("[Shop2] Sending buy success event → slot =", slot)

    state.items[slot] = nil

    self:SendUpdate(pid)

    CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToPlayer(
        player,
        "shop2_buy_success",
        {
            slot = slot,
            ability = offer.ability,
            level = offer.level,
            currency = currency,
            price = price,
        }
    )

    -- print("[Shop2] Buy process finished")
    -- print("==========================================\n")
end

function Shop2Manager:AddAbility(hero, pid, name, image, lvl)
    -- print("[Shop2] Adding ability:", name)

    local ability = hero:FindAbilityByName(name)

    if not ability then
        --print("[Shop2] Ability does not exist, adding new ability...")
        ability = hero:AddAbility(name)
    end

    if not ability then
        print("[Shop2][ERROR] Failed to add/find ability:", name)
        return
    end

    ability.raw_name = name
    ability:AddInstance(lvl)

    -- print("[Shop2]", name, lvl)

    local inv = self:GetInventory(pid)

    local foundIndex = nil
    for i, entry in ipairs(inv) do
        if entry.ability == name and entry.level == lvl then
            foundIndex = i
            break
        end
    end

    local now = GameRules:GetGameTime()

    if foundIndex then
        -- 已有：次数 +1，并且移到最前面
        local entry = inv[foundIndex]
        entry.count = (entry.count or 1) + 1
        entry.last_time = now

        table.remove(inv, foundIndex)
        table.insert(inv, 1, entry)
    else
        -- 新记录，插入到最前
        table.insert(inv, 1, {
            ability   = name,
            level     = lvl,
            count     = 1,
            image     = image, -- KV 里的 Image
            last_time = now,
        })
    end

    -- 同步给客户端
    self:SendInventory(pid)

    -- print("[Shop2] Ability added successfully → level set to", lvl)
end

function Shop2Manager:ReAddAbility(pid, hero)
    local inv = self:GetInventory(pid)
    -- DeepPrintTable(inv)
    for index, value in ipairs(inv) do
        local name = value.ability
        local lvl = value.level
        local ability = hero:FindAbilityByName(name)
        if not ability then
            --print("[Shop2] Ability does not exist, adding new ability...")
            ability = hero:AddAbility(name)
        end

        ability.raw_name = name

        for i = 1, value.count, 1 do
            ability:AddInstance(lvl)
            -- print("[Shop2 ReAdd]", name, lvl)
        end
    end
end

+Shop1 物品生命周期
+
+一、范围与入口
+- 物品配置：`scripts/npc/item stats/shop1_items.txt`（由 kv-sync 生成）。
+- Shop1 管理：`scripts/vscripts/shop1_manager.lua`。
+- 物品实例入口：`scripts/vscripts/abilities/item_base.lua`。
+- 战斗与弹幕：见 `game/dzsj/scripts/utils/md/autocast.md`。
+- 强化与选择：见 `game/dzsj/scripts/utils/md/enhance.md`。
+
+二、数据结构（Slots）
+- `Shop1Manager.Slots[slot]`：
+  - `-1` 表示空位。
+  - `{ Stats, Autocast, Dummy, Moving }` 为已占用。
+- Slot 位置来自 `GameState.spawn_points[pid].good`。
+
+三、获取与生成
+1) 来源
+- 商店购买：`shop_buy_request` → `Shop1Manager:OnBuyRequest`。
+- 奖励掉落：`spawn_manager:GiveRewardToPlayer` → `Shop1Manager:AddItemRandomly`。
+- 测试/调试：`test_mode.lua` 提供加等级入口。
+2) AddItem 核心流程
+- 选择空 slot（无可用 slot 则直接返回）。
+- 创建/获取 `<item>_<lvl>` ability，并调用 `AddInstance_Shop1`：
+  - `modifier_item_stats`：读取 BonusAttribute，写入 `StatsManager:AddSource`。
+  - `modifier_item_autocast_controller`：创建 dummy 并挂 `modifier_dummy_autocast`。
+- 写入 `Slots[slot] = { Stats, Autocast }`，并记录 `Autocast.pid/slot/custom_level`。
+- 额外逻辑：
+  - `SpawnWallManager:OnShop1DummyRecruited`（首次占位时）。
+  - 支援职业奖励（Career=Support → 额外 gold）。
+  - 强化池更新（`Shop1EnhanceManager:OnItemAcquired`）。
+  - 4 级时触发强化选择（`StartSelection`）。
+
+四、战斗与表现
+- dummy 由 `modifier_item_autocast_controller` 创建并维护。
+- 编队/星级/选中代理与视觉 dummy 在同一 controller 内处理。
+- 实际伤害与目标选择规则见 `autocast.md`。
+
+五、选择与拖拽
+- `selection.lua` 监听选择事件：
+  - 代理 dummy 会被强制单选，并映射回主 dummy。
+  - 选中时向 UI 推送 `shop1_dummy_selection`。
+- `filters.lua` 处理拖拽：
+  - `MOVE_TO_POSITION`/`ATTACK_TARGET` 会尝试合成或触发拖拽逻辑。
+- `HandleDummyDrag` 规则：
+  - 若目标为空位：当前版本不移动（保持原位）。
+  - 若目标为同类同级且可合成：触发合成动画。
+
+六、合成（等级提升）
+- 规则：同 dummy 名称、同等级、且等级 < 4。
+- 两种路径：
+  - `SynthesizePairSlotsImmediate`：直接删除并生成新等级。
+  - `SynthesizePairSlotsAnimated`：动画结束后删除并生成新等级。
+- 自动合成：`HandleSynthesizeByPID` / `Synthesize` 扫描所有 slot。
+
+七、回收与重建
+- `RemoveItem(slot)`：
+  - 标记 dummy 停止与暂停施法。
+  - 清理 WorldPanel 与选中状态。
+  - 延迟销毁 `Stats`/`Autocast` modifiers。
+- `DestroyAllItems`：逐 slot 调用 `RemoveItem`。
+- `RemoveAndStoreItems` / `ReAddItem`：
+  - 用于角色切换时缓存与恢复。
+- 强化刷新：`RefreshItemsForEnhance` 会重新移除并按原 slot 重建。
+
+八、设计约定
+- 拖拽到空位与互换逻辑当前关闭，避免意外移动。
+- 合成只基于 dummy 名称与等级判定，不检查能力本体。
+- 4 级为上限；合成或升级超过 4 会直接返回。
*** End Patch
